outer_split_binding: Historical audited HTRU2 five-fold splits; exact data/split identity in protocols/data_contract.json and sources/bindings.json.

common_downstream.seed: seed(outer_fold, final_model), identical across all seven arms

l1_selector.selection: Per C/per inner fold: encoder+L1 ranking fitted only to inner train; top4; fresh encoder+common LR fitted to same inner train; mean validation F1 selects C; final ranking rebuilt on complete outer training pool.
l1_selector.coefficient_zero_or_tie: original feature order; report zero_count and tie_count

forward_selector.preprocessing: fresh encoder on each candidate inner training fold

failure_policy: ConvergenceWarning becomes failed counted attempt; exceptions fail current unit; no hidden retries, retuning, seed replacement or C rescue.
inner_fold_algorithm: Sort each class by row ID, one seeded RNG permutes class0 then class1, np.array_split into3, sort each validation set, complementary training sets.
test_information_boundary: Selectors only receive TrainingPool; loader must bind exact train/test/group IDs, prove singleton groups and no missing data, save immutable selections before held-out metrics.

endpoints.primary: Five paired per-fold F1 contrasts ASSS111 minus every same-k traditional arm; all folds plus mean.
endpoints.all_features_context: k=8 context, excluded from same-k claim

resource_inventory.unit: One explicit top-level estimator.fit or encoder.fit attempt, including failures.
resource_inventory.replay_cache_policy: Cold replay shares no fitted objects, preprocessing or utility cache with main.
resource_inventory.audit_targets: Every final arm/fold; every full-feature coalition in B=4 games and 3 utility folds per outer fold.

wall_time_gates.training_probe: 16 LR-family plus16 fixed RF fits; each uses all8 features and the complete bound outer-fold0 TRAIN pool with a fresh numeric encoder. LR indices0..5 use common L2 LR C1; indices6..15 use L1/liblinear with C_grid[(i-6)//2], two repetitions per C. RF indices0..15 use fixed RF. Use corresponding probe_lr/probe_rf seeds. No test input or metric. Record row counts, each duration and weighted projections separately for common LR, every L1 C and RF across selection/final/audit/replay before main. Repeated full-pool timing is a conservative gate, not an unbiased end-to-end cost estimate.
wall_time_gates.on_limit: checkpoint finished immutable units; record in-progress failed/started operations; no next unit
wall_time_gates.watchdog_status: must be implemented and tested before any actual fit; Python post-fit timing alone is not a wall-time kill guarantee

audit.direct_refits: 7 final arms each fold + full-feature utility coalition for each of4 contribution games and3 utility folds each fold
audit.cold_replay: All seven methods, contributions, preprocessing and finals of outer fold0, same seeds but fresh caches/estimators.
audit.replay_audit: Compare replay selections, deterministic scores/probabilities and substantive artifacts with main; no additional replay-specific refits.
audit.no_operation_resume: Required before A3.1 delivery; independent audit must not count unit-test simulated operations as real attempts

PowerSHAP.gate: Separately freeze lawful package/version/source commit/API, native variable-k rules, learner, automatic mode, thresholds, complete internal fit accounting, resource caps and training-only feasibility.

known_execution_gates: Current usage/reserve gate before indivisible package
Root durable ledger with pre-reserve and failure accounting
F storage writable and resolved paths verified
Training-only probe within frozen operation/time budgets
Immutable result/selection persistence and restore-safe resume
Independent audit/replay command implementation and first-package validation
storage_binding: protocols/storage.json is authoritative; future execution must resolve and verify its effective paths before writing.
